transition.title: transition
transition.history: Smoothly animate property changes (hover, focus, class toggles). Simple and performant for UI micro-interactions.
transition.code:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>transition Example</title>
<style>
  .btn { background:#2563eb; color:#fff; padding:12px 18px; border-radius:8px; transition: all 0.3s ease; display:inline-block; }
  .btn:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); background:#1e40af; }
  body { font-family: Arial, sans-serif; padding:24px; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
  <button class="btn">Hover me</button>
</body>
</html>
transition.quiz: Which property creates smooth hover/focus transitions?
